titleEn: Royal decrees No. 0819/1300 on the establishment of Phnom Penh Appeal Court

articles.en:
.
- The Phnom Penh Court of Appeal and the General Prosecutor’s Office attached to the Phnom Penh Court of Appeal shall receive and decide appeals against the decisions of the First Instance Court of Phnom Penh and the Prosecutor’s Office attached thereto, and of the First Instance Court of Kandal Province and the Prosecutor’s Office attached thereto, or cases remitted by the Supreme Court.
All cases that the Phnom Penh Court of Appeal and the General Prosecutor’s Office attached to the Phnom Penh Court of Appeal have received within their jurisdiction shall continue to be handled in accordance with the laws and regulations in force.
In the event that a Regional Court of Appeal and the General Prosecutor’s Office attached to any regional Court of Appeal are not yet operational, appeals in that region shall fall within the jurisdiction of the Phnom Penh Court of Appeal and the General Prosecutor’s Office attached to the Phnom Penh Court of Appeal.
- All provisions contrary to this Royal Decree shall be considered null and void.

- The Supreme Council of the Magistracy and Samdech Akka Moha Sena Padei Techo Hun Sen, Prime Minister of the Kingdom of Cambodia, shall be responsible for implementing this Royal Decree from the date of signature onwards.
[Illegible in source: seal and registration number]
Norodom Sihamoni; at the Royal Palace, 07 August 2019; certified true copy of the original.
Council of Ministers.
